name: The Hand of Rastakhan
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
adventurer, our worst fears have come.  Legend speaks of the Soulflayer ruling the ancient troll world through evil and terror, and his power was absolute.  If he cannot be stopped now, then his new reign may spread across all of Azeroth!

There is a contingent of Zandalarian trolls who may help us stem this tide of darkness.  They have camped on Yojamba Isle, off the coast of Stranglethorn, west of the ruins of Zul'Kunda.  Speak with their leader, Molthor, and pray he knows how to defeat Hakkar.
narrative.offerRewardText:
You were sent by the prospector, Ironboot?  His kind are wise, and wiser still to bring you to me, for I and the Zandalarian trolls may know a way to defeat the Soulflayer.

Speak with the trolls of this isle, heed their words, and prepare yourself, adventurer, for the task before you is soaked in blood.

chain.subtitle: 8 quests from level 44 to 58, 53,800 XP in all.

quests.name: Screecher Spirits
quests.objectiveText: Capture the spirits of 3 screechers in Feralas, then return to Yeh'kinya in Steamwheedle Port.

quests.name: The Prophecy of Mosh'aru
quests.objectiveText: Bring the First and Second Mosh'aru Tablets to Yeh'kinya in Tanaris.

quests.name: The Ancient Egg
quests.objectiveText: Bring the Ancient Egg to Yeh'kinya in Tanaris.

quests.name: The God Hakkar
quests.objectiveText: Bring the Filled Egg of Hakkar to Yeh'kinya in Tanaris.

quests.name: The Lost Tablets of Mosh'aru
quests.objectiveText: Bring the Third and Fourth Mosh'aru Tablets to Prospector Ironboot in Tanaris.

quests.name: The Final Tablets
quests.objectiveText: Bring the Fifth and Sixth Mosh'aru Tablets to Prospector Ironboot in Tanaris.
